lines.text: The root is Lect! Legend, neglect.
Lect is Latin for gather or choose.
Legend: a story to be read.
Quick quiz! Which means not plus gather?

data.src_mean: to gather, to read, to choose

words.ex: According to legend, a dragon lived in the lake.
Don't neglect your health when you are busy.

publish.title: Lect root: legend and neglect
publish.value: Lect comes from Latin "legere" (to gather, to read, to choose). Words: legend and neglect. neglect = neg + lect.
